results.description: Every transaction satisfies (signed_amount<0 iff direction='Debit') AND (signed_amount>0 iff direction='Credit') AND amount = abs(signed_amount)
results.query_or_script:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM transactions
WHERE NOT (
  ( (signed_amount < 0 AND direction = 'Debit')
    OR (signed_amount > 0 AND direction = 'Credit')
    OR (signed_amount = 0)
  )
  AND ( ABS(amount - ABS(signed_amount)) < 0.005 )
)
